answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The yarrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the mirror of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
